decisions.reason: As a close complement to the core flooring business and a survivor of the first review cycle, the maintenance oil would likely be retained unless its sales and margin now persistently fall below aspiration.
This care product serves a narrower installed base of oiled floors, but it still fits the firm's system offering and would usually be kept while performance remains acceptably close to aspiration.

The moisture-protection underlay supports installation quality and cross-selling with floors, so management would likely keep it unless comparative results versus other accessories clearly disappoint.

The high-density underlay foam remains the most drop-prone because it is more substitutable and may overlap with adjacent underlays, but in a growing firm it is still more likely to be retained unless continued results trigger problemistic search.
